pla-01.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: AAC vocabulary image. Style: flat 2D educational illustration, simple solid colors, dark clear outlines, no 3D or photographic textures. Four whole female figures side by side showing AGE progression: little girl, teenage girl, adult woman, elderly white-haired woman with glasses. Simple red arrow below points toward older. Clearly different heights and life stages. Plain modest clothes, no text or numbers. Pure white background. One clear central concept, minimal necessary context, generous white margins on ALL sides. All people full body and all objects fully inside image, natural anatomy/hands. Anatomical detail may use natural body-part crop. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, punctuation, lettering, labels, branding, watermarks or pseudowriting anywhere, including tiny hardware and clothing. No border. Image square. Vocabulary word is displayed outside image by the app, never inside.
